'''Boran''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He served aboard the ''[[Brentaal Star]]''.<ref name="Black Talon" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You never should've attacked us!|Boran speaks to the player aboard the ''Black Talon''|<ref name="Black Talon" />}}
Sergeant Boran is the leader of the first boss group in Flashpoint: the Black Talon in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Boran and his group appear only if players choose the '''Light Side''' option during their conversation with Captain [[Revinal Orzik|Orzik]], keeping him alive. Community consensus reflects that Imperial players chose only the dark side option and therefore Boran's attack did not occur. It is unknown what happened to Boran and his team, or if they even existed, according to the canonical scenario. Since [[Sylas]] orders the shuttles to be shot down, it is possible Boran and his squad were shot down and perished before they could even reach the Black Talon in the dark side option.
